F01.name: hard-gated feedback ingress
F01.role: clean material enters memory through a hard gate, usually with `.layer(material.mask(gate))`

F02.name: compound/interleaved feedback accumulation
F02.role: feedback path mixes repeated layers, modulation, or global blend pressure in one recurrence

F03.name: multi-buffer staged circuit
F03.role: extra buffers hold material, field, composite, render, or parallel feedback responsibilities

F04.name: feed-forward lattice/source construction
F04.role: shape/noise/osc program constructs a material, mask, or source without closed feedback as the main fact

F05.name: metric raster / pixel-grid form
F05.role: width/height, repeat, pixelate, or raster oscillator math controls exact grid or scanline structure

F06.name: axis-packed vector field
F06.role: x and y displacement responsibilities are built separately then packed into R/G

F07.name: transform-delta coordinate field
F07.role: a coordinate operation becomes a UV field by subtracting the identity gradient

F08.name: channel / chroma carrier
F08.role: R/G/B extraction, hue, colorama, or modulateHue is structural rather than just decoration

F09.name: kaleid / symmetry recurrence
F09.role: kaleid symmetry is used as material, field, mask, or feedback conditioner

F10.name: global artifact / blend-pressure feedback
F10.role: diff, sub, add, or blend acts on feedback memory globally or semi-globally

F11.name: spectral conditioner feedback
F11.role: blur, dualKawaseBlur, sharpen, or edgeDetect introduces low/high frequency recurrence pressure

F12.name: parameter-signal receiver form
F12.role: texture-valued controls replace arrays/callbacks and drive parameters with range, grain, or activation density

F13.name: direct-transform legacy form
F13.role: scale, rotate, scroll, and friends act directly on feedback/material before being rewritten into fields
